invariants.rationale: The context is expected to be a valid engine context object; most Hoodie table methods require non-null context.
Option objects are typically non-null (presence/absence encoded in isPresent()) for clarity and uniformity.
If extraMetadata is present, then get() returns a non-null Map; if not present, get() should not be used.
If extraMetadata is present, it is likely to contain metadata entries; Option is rarely present with empty value.
If extraMetadata is present, its value is a Map whose size is always non-negative.
